blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Automatic soccer event spotting supports highlight generation, video indexing, and sports analytics, but existing methods depend on large annotated datasets and soccer-specific training. We present a zero-shot framework that detects, classifies, and temporally localizes events in full-length soccer broadcasts without task-specific parameter training. Each match is segmented into overlapping clips represented by a compact visual storyboard and the aligned commentary transcript, which a general-purpose multimodal model processes jointly. On three manually annotated matches containing 130 events, the best configuration achieves 72.0% F1@5s and outperforms SoccerNet-trained CALF and NetVLAD++ in a cross-dataset setting, while the storyboard representation reduces inference cost by 72% compared with individual frames. We further analyze the effects of model family, input representation, and prompt optimization, and introduce an evidence-grounded excitement-scoring stage that ranks detected events with natural-language explanations for highlight selection.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Soccer broadcasts contain long periods of routine gameplay interrupted by
sparse but important events such as goals, shots, misses, corners, kickoffs,
and disciplinary actions. Automatically detecting and temporally localizing
these events supports applications such as highlight generation, video
indexing, content retrieval, and sports analytics. This task is commonly
formulated as action spotting, where events must be recognized and localized
within complete, untrimmed matches [ 1 , 2 ] . It remains challenging because
events are brief, visually similar across classes, and often surrounded by
replays, celebrations, and recap sequences.

blocks.en:
Existing soccer action-spotting approaches largely rely on task-specific
models trained on annotated datasets. Prior work has improved performance
through temporal modeling and multimodal information [ 3 , 4 ] , while
soccer-specific frameworks such as MatchVision [ 5 ] and SoccerMaster [ 6 ] use large-scale domain-specific training. These approaches can be
effective but require soccer-specific data, training, and computational
resources.

Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer an alternative by jointly
reasoning over visual and textual information without task-specific parameter
fine-tuning. Recent work has also demonstrated their ability to reason about
temporal information in long videos [ 7 ] . However, applying general-purpose
MLLMs to full soccer broadcasts requires detecting sparse events, distinguishing
closely related outcomes, temporally localizing them, and handling replay or
recap content.

blocks.en:
In this work, we investigate zero-shot multimodal event spotting and temporal
localization directly from complete soccer broadcasts. We study five questions
covering zero-shot feasibility ( RQ1 ), multimodal input representation
( RQ2 ), prompt optimization
( RQ3 ), comparison with supervised soccer-specific methods
( RQ4 ), and multimodal excitement scoring ( RQ5 ). Full soccer matches are divided into overlapping clips represented using sparse visual information and aligned commentary, from which general-purpose multimodal models jointly predict event categories and their temporal locations.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are:

blocks.en: II Related Works
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工程

blocks.en: II-A Soccer Event Spotting and Multimodal Understanding
blocks.zh: II-A 足球活动观察和多式联运

blocks.en:
SoccerNet [ 1 ] and SoccerNet-v2 [ 2 ] established benchmarks
for event spotting in soccer broadcasts. Subsequent methods improved
temporal modeling through context-aware learning [ 3 ] , feature
aggregation [ 11 ] , and transformer architectures [ 10 , 12 , 18 ] .
Multimodal methods incorporate audio and commentary [ 4 , 17 ] ,
while MatchVision [ 5 ] and SoccerMaster [ 6 ] employ
soccer-specific representation learning. X-VARS [ 13 ] explores
multimodal refereeing, and Jiang et al. [ 14 ] investigate
domain adaptation of vision-language models. In contrast, we study
zero-shot event spotting in full-length broadcasts using general-purpose
multimodal models without task-specific parameter training.

在足球广播中播放节目。 改进了随后的方法
通过了解背景的学习进行时间建模[3],特征
汇总 [11],和变压器架构 [10,12,18].
多式联运方法包括音频和评注[4、17],
而Match Visions [5] 和 SoccerMaster [6] 则使用
足球特有表现学习. X-VARS [13] 探索
多式联运裁判,以及Jiang et al. [14] 调查
视觉语言模型的域适应。 相反,我们研究
使用一般目的进行全长广播的零射事件观察
没有任务特定参数培训的多式联运模式。

blocks.en: II-B Multimodal Temporal Reasoning and Prompt Optimization
blocks.zh: II-B 多式联运临时理由和迅速优化

blocks.en:
TimeChat [ 7 ] , Grounded-VideoLLM [ 15 ] , and TimeSuite [ 16 ] improve temporal video understanding through specialized
representations or training. We instead evaluate general-purpose
models for event detection and localization without fine-tuning.
We also investigate MIPROv2 [ 9 ] and GEPA [ 8 ] , which
optimize prompts using task performance and reflection, respectively,
to assess their effects on detection and temporal localization.

blocks.en: III Methodology
blocks.zh: 三、结 论 方法

blocks.en: III-A Dataset
blocks.zh: 数据集

blocks.en: Our evaluation dataset consists of three full-length soccer broadcasts from publicly available YouTube videos. All three are professionally produced multi-camera broadcast feeds with standard broadcast editing, including camera cuts, close-up views, replays, and retrospective recap sequences, rather than recordings from a single stationary camera. The matches were manually annotated with temporal intervals for six event categories: goal, shot, miss, corner, kickoff, and yellow card, resulting in 130 annotated events. The source video URLs, temporal annotations, and evaluation metadata are publicly available in our GitHub repository .
blocks.zh: 我们的评价数据集包括从公开的YouTube视频播放的3个完整的足球广播。 这三部作品都是专业制作的多相机广播素材,有标准的广播剪辑,包括相机剪辑,特写观看,重播,以及回顾性重现序列,而不是从单台固定相机录制. 比赛用人工说明时间间隔,分为6个活动类别:进球,射门,失球,转角,踢球,和黄牌,共产生130个附加说明的活动. 源视频 URL、时间说明和评价元数据在我们GitHub仓库中公开。

blocks.en: Each match is segmented into 15-second clips with a 5-second overlap, with 15 frames uniformly sampled per clip. Commentary is transcribed using Whisper Medium and aligned with each clip. We use this configuration as the default after preliminary experiments with shorter, denser clips produced higher recall but lower precision.
blocks.zh: 每场比赛被分成15秒的片段,5秒重叠,每个片段15帧统一取样. 注释使用Whisper Medium转录,并与每个片段对齐. 我们使用这种配置作为默认,在用更短,更密集的夹片进行初步实验后,产生了更高的回弹量,但精度较低.

blocks.zh: 三-C 管道概况

blocks.en:
As illustrated in Fig. 1 , the framework processes overlapping
clips using sparse frame sampling, storyboard construction, commentary
alignment, multimodal event detection, temporal localization, consolidation,
and excitement scoring.

blocks.en: III-C 1 Sparse Frame Sampling
blocks.zh: III-C 1 样本框架

blocks.en:
Frames are uniformly sampled across each clip to provide observations throughout
the temporal window. The default configuration extracts 15 frames from each
15-second clip.

blocks.en: III-C 2 Storyboard Construction
blocks.zh: III-C 2 故事板建设

blocks.en:
Sampled frames are resized to 384 × 216 384\times 216 pixels and arranged
chronologically into a single storyboard, with each frame associated with its
relative timestamp. For the default 15-frame configuration, the frames are
organized in a 5 × 3 5\times 3 grid, resulting in a storyboard resolution of 1920 × 648 1920\times 648 pixels. This compact representation allows the model to
reason over temporal progression within a single visual input while reducing
the number of separate visual inputs. We compare this representation with
providing the same sampled frames individually at the same per-frame
resolution.

blocks.en: III-C 6 Temporal Consolidation
blocks.zh: 临时合并

blocks.en: Subsequent overlapping clips can produce multiple predictions for the same event. Predictions are grouped by event category and ordered by absolute timestamp. Same-class detections are clustered using a 20-second temporal window, with a 30-second window for goals and corners, and the highest-confidence prediction in each cluster is retained. Predictions from different event classes are never merged.
blocks.zh: 随后的重叠片段可以对同一事件产生多个预测. 预测按事件类别分组,按绝对时间戳排序. 同级检测采用20秒时间窗口进行分组,对目标与角设置30秒窗口,保留每组中最高的自信预测. 不同事件类的预测从未合并.

blocks.en: III-D Prompt Optimization
blocks.zh: 三-D 快速优化

blocks.en:
We compare manually designed and automatically optimized prompts while keeping
model parameters fixed.
blocks.zh:
我们比较手动设计和自动优化的提示,同时保留
模型参数固定。

blocks.en:
Our primary prompt is designed for the storyboard representation. It defines
the event taxonomy, provides event-specific decision guidance, and instructs
the model to reason jointly over the temporally ordered visual evidence and
aligned commentary. The model considers the progression of the clip before
assigning an event label and is instructed to distinguish live events from
replay or recap segments. Predictions follow a structured format containing
the event decision, category, relative timestamp, confidence score, and
supporting visual and textual evidence.
blocks.zh:
我们的首要提示是为故事板的显示而设计的。 它定义
提供针对特定事件的决策指导,并指示
在暂时订购的视觉证据上共同说明理由的模型和
合并评注。 模型考虑片段的进化
指定事件标签,并指示区分活动
重放或重现片段。 预测遵循结构化格式,包含
事件决定、类别、相对时间戳、信任分,以及
支持视觉和文字证据。

blocks.en:
We additionally evaluate a two-prompt configuration that separates recognition
from verification. The first prompt performs event recognition and coarse
temporal localization, while the second re-examines the initial prediction and
multimodal evidence to produce the final event decision and refined timestamp.
This tests whether separating initial recognition from verification improves
prediction reliability.
blocks.zh:
我们额外评价了一种将识别区分开的两时配置
从核查。 第一个快速执行事件识别和粗糙
时间定位,而第二个则重新审查初步预测和
提出最后事件决定的多式联运证据和完善的时间戳。
检验将初始识别与核查区分开来是否会改进
预测可靠性。

blocks.en: We additionally apply GEPA and MIPROv2 to investigate whether the manually designed instructions can be systematically improved. Both methods use labeled development examples to optimize task-specific instructions. Separate training, validation, and held-out test splits are used while all model parameters remain fixed. The optimization modifies the textual instructions and reasoning guidance while preserving the event taxonomy, multimodal input representation, and structured output format. The optimized prompts are fixed and applied unchanged during full-match inference. Thus, GEPA and MIPROv2 perform label-guided prompt optimization without task-specific parameter fine-tuning, allowing us to examine how prompt structure affects detection and temporal localization within the same parameter-frozen inference framework.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们还应用GEPA和MIPROv2来调查是否可以系统地改进人工设计的指示。 两种方法都使用标签化的开发实例来优化特定任务指令. 使用单独的训练、验证和停产试验分解,同时所有模型参数保持不变。 优化修改了文字说明和推理指导,同时保留了事件分类法,多式联运输入表示法,以及结构化输出格式. 优化的提示是固定的,在完全匹配推论时应用不变. 因此,GEPA和MIPROv2在没有针对特定任务的参数微调的情况下进行标签制导的即时优化,使我们能够审查即时结构如何影响同一参数-冻结推论框架内的检测和时间定位。

blocks.en: III-E Models
blocks.zh: 三-E 模式

blocks.en:
We evaluate several models under the same zero-shot soccer event-detection
setting, including GPT-5.5, GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-5.6 Terra, GPT-5.6 Luna,
Qwen3.5-4B, and Qwen3-VL-8B Embedding. The GPT variants are selected to

blocks.en: For excitement analysis, we evaluate the 175 post-consolidation predictions belonging to the six event categories used in the main event-spotting evaluation. Each retained event is scored once, avoiding repeated assessments of the same event arising from overlapping clips. GPT-5.4 Mini scores each event using its predicted category, detection confidence, supporting visual evidence, and aligned transcript rather than reprocessing the original video.

blocks.en: IV Evaluation
blocks.zh: 四 评价

blocks.en: IV-A Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: IV-A 评价议定书

blocks.en:
We evaluate event detection using event-level precision, recall, F1 score,
mean Average Precision (mAP), and temporal localization error. Since predictions
are single timestamps while ground-truth events are temporal intervals, a
prediction is temporally matched if it lies within the annotated interval or
within a predefined tolerance around it.
blocks.zh:
我们用事件水平的精确度来评估事件检测, 回忆,F1分数,
平均精度( mAP) 和时间定位错误 。 由于预测
地面真相事件是时间间隔,a
如果预测位于附加说明的间隔内,或
在它周围预先设定的容忍度

blocks.en:
Unless otherwise stated, we use a temporal tolerance of ± 5 \pm 5 seconds. A
prediction is a true positive (TP) when it matches a ground-truth event of the
same category within this tolerance. Unmatched predictions are false positives
(FP), and unmatched ground-truth events are false negatives (FN). Each
prediction and ground-truth event can participate in at most one match. The 130 annotated events constitute the ground-truth set for the six-class event-spotting evaluation. Prediction counts are computed after temporal consolidation and therefore need not equal the ground-truth count; unmatched predictions are counted as false positives.
blocks.zh:
除非另有说明,否则我们使用时间容忍度为±5\pm 5秒. A级
预测值是真实的正值(TP),如果它与地面真实事件相符。
容忍度的相同类别。 无法匹配的预测是假阳性
(FP),和无与伦比的地面真相事件都是虚假的负面(FN). 每个
预测和地面真实事件最多可以参加一场比赛。 130项附加说明的活动构成六级活动定点评价的地面实况。 预测性计数是在时间合并后计算的,因此,无需等同于地面真实性计数;未匹配的预测被计算为虚假的正数。

blocks.en:
We report Precision@5s, Recall@5s, and F1@5s. For matched events,
temporal localization is measured by the mean absolute error (MAE)
between each prediction and its ground-truth interval, taken as zero
inside the interval and as the distance to the nearest boundary otherwise. For mAP, predictions for each event category are ranked by confidence and
average precision (AP) is computed from the resulting precision–recall curve.
mAP is obtained by averaging AP across event categories using the same ± 5 \pm 5 -second temporal matching criterion.

我们报告精确度@5、召回度@5和F1@5。 对于相应的事件,
时间本地化用平均绝对误差( MAE) 测量
每个预测与其地面真实间隔之间, 以0为单位
除此以外,作为距离最近的边界。 就mAP而言,对每个事件类别的预测按置信度和
平均精确度(AP)是从所产生的精度-召回曲线计算出来的。
页:1 AP是通过使用相同的±5\pm 5 -秒时间匹配标准对事件类别进行平均AP获得的.

blocks.en: IV-B Excitement-Score Evaluation
blocks.zh: 四-B 热情-分数评价

blocks.en: We assess excitement-score consistency over the same 175 post-consolidation event predictions using two LLM-based judges: FlowJudge [ 20 ] and GPT-5.6 Sol. Each judge receives the predicted event category, extracted visual evidence, and aligned commentary, while the original GPT-5.4 Mini excitement score, confidence, and explanation are withheld to avoid anchoring. Both judges assign scores on the same 0–10 scale. Because the intended application is event ranking, Spearman’s rank correlation ( ρ \rho ) [ 19 ] is the primary agreement metric; we additionally report mean absolute error (MAE) to characterize differences in absolute score calibration.
blocks.zh: 我们用两个基于LLM的判断来评估 175次合并后事件预测的兴奋分数一致性: 流程法官[20]和GPT-5.6 Sol. 每位法官都会收到预测的事件类别,提取视觉证据,以及对齐的评论,而最初的GPT-5.4迷你兴奋分数,信心和解释则被扣下以避免锚定. 两名法官都按同样的0至10级评分。 因为预期的应用是事件排名,所以斯皮尔曼的排名相关性(ρ\rho)[19]是主要协议的衡量标准;我们额外报告指绝对差错(MAE)来描述绝对分数校准的差异.

blocks.en: V Results
blocks.zh: 五 结果

blocks.en:
All experiments were conducted using AWS EC2 g5.2xlarge instances as
the common experimental environment. Preprocessing, feature extraction,
baseline execution, and open-source model inference were performed locally,
while API-based multimodal models were accessed through their respective APIs.
Results are organized around the five research questions introduced earlier.

所有实验均使用AWS EC2 g5.2x大例进行,作为
共同的实验环境 预处理 特性提取
基线执行以及开源模型推论在当地进行,
而基于API的多式联运模型则通过各自的API访问.
成果是围绕先前提出的五个研究问题编排的。

blocks.en:
Although GEPA and MIPROv2 are designed to improve task-specific prompting,
their gains are limited in our setting because many errors arise from the
multimodal evidence itself rather than from the textual instructions alone.
Sparse visual sampling, ambiguous event outcomes, and broadcast or recap content
can leave insufficient evidence for distinguishing closely related events.
Prompt optimization can therefore modify the detector’s decision behavior,
but it cannot recover visual or temporal information that is absent from the
input. This helps explain why the optimized prompts improve some classes or
temporal localization without consistently improving overall F1.
blocks.zh:
虽然GEPA和MIPROv2旨在改进特定任务的激励,
他们的收益在我们的环境下是有限的,因为许多错误产生于
多式联运本身而不是仅从文本指示中证明。
图像取样、模糊事件结果和广播或内容摘要
无法为区分密切相关的事件留下足够的证据。
因此,快速优化可以改变探测器的决定行为,
但它无法恢复在下列情况下缺失的视觉或时间信息:
输入。 这帮助解释为什么优化的提示会改进一些课程或
时间定位没有持续改善整体F1.

blocks.en:
Overall, RQ3 shows that automatic prompt optimization does not uniformly
improve event spotting but changes the detector’s precision, recall, temporal
localization, and class sensitivity. MIPROv2 favors broader event coverage,
while GEPA improves temporal localization but has lower aggregate detection
performance. The manually designed storyboard prompt achieves the highest
Recall@5s and F1@5s among the evaluated strategies.
blocks.zh:
总体而言,RQ3显示自动即时优化并不一致
改善事件观察, 但改变探测器的精确度、 回忆、 时间
本地化和阶级敏感性。 MIPROv2更喜欢更广泛的事件报道,

blocks.en:
We compare the proposed zero-shot multimodal approach with CALF and NetVLAD++,
two supervised action-spotting models pretrained on SoccerNet. Both baselines
are evaluated on the same three matches using the same six-class taxonomy and
temporal evaluation protocol.

blocks.en:
Under this common six-class evaluation, the strongest zero-shot multimodal
configurations achieve higher precision, recall, F1@5s, and mAP@5s than the

SoccerNet and evaluated here without retraining. Their results therefore
represent cross-dataset transfer rather than their original in-domain

characteristics may affect the comparison.

特性可能影响比较。

blocks.en:
Overall, RQ4 shows that general-purpose multimodal models can achieve
strong cross-dataset soccer event-spotting performance without soccer-specific

blocks.en: We evaluate excitement scoring over 175 post-consolidation event predictions across the three matches and six event categories. Unlike the clip-level detector outputs, each retained prediction represents a single event candidate after temporal consolidation, preventing overlapping detections of the same event from being counted repeatedly.
blocks.zh: 我们评价兴奋分数超过175 合并后的事件预测 跨越三个匹配和六个事件类别。 与剪贴级探测器的输出不同,每次保留的预测在时间整合后代表单个事件候选,防止同一事件的重复探测被反复计算.

blocks.en: As shown in Table VI , GPT-5.4 Mini assigns an overall mean excitement score of 5.07. Goals receive the highest average score (7.87), followed by shots (5.81) and misses (5.03), while corners (2.66), kickoffs (2.44), and yellow cards (2.36) receive lower scores. This ordering is broadly preserved by both LLM-based judges, indicating that the scoring framework differentiates events according to estimated highlight relevance.
blocks.zh: 如表六所示,GPT-5.4 Mini指定的总平均兴奋分为5.07。 进球平均得分最高(7.87),其次是射击(5.81)和失球(5.03),而角数(2.66),踢球(2.44)和黄牌(2.36)的得分较低。 以LLM为基础的两位法官广泛保留了这一命令,表明评分框架根据估计的突出相关性区分事件。

blocks.en: To assess scoring consistency, we compare GPT-5.4 Mini with FlowJudge and a stronger GPT-based judge. As shown in Table VII, FlowJudge achieves an overall Spearman rank correlation of ρ = 0.716 \rho=0.716 with an MAE of 1.37, while the GPT-based judge achieves substantially stronger agreement with ρ = 0.926 \rho=0.926 and an MAE of 0.64. FlowJudge assigns a lower mean score than GPT-5.4 Mini (4.46 versus 5.07), indicating more conservative absolute-score calibration, whereas the GPT-based judge produces a similar overall mean score (5.25). Positive rank agreement is observed across all three matches for both judges.
blocks.zh: 为了评估评分的一致性,我们将GPT-5.4Mini与流动法官以及更强大的基于GPT的法官进行比较。 如表七所示,流动法官的斯皮尔曼排名总体相关性为: ^ = 0.716\rho=0.716,最高比率为1.37,而基于GPT的法官则与 $ = 0.926\rho=0.926和最高比率为0.64达成实质上更强有力的协议。 Flow Judge分配的平均分数低于GPT-5.4 Mini(4.46比5.07),表示绝对分数的校准更为保守,而基于GPT的法官则得出类似的总体平均分数(5.25). 所有三名法官的级别均符合正数。

blocks.en: Overall, RQ5 demonstrates consistent excitement ranking across two LLM-based judges, while human evaluation remains necessary to establish alignment with perceived highlight relevance.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,RQ5显示,在两名基于LLM的法官中,始终保持了激动人心的排名,而人类评价仍有必要与所认为的突出相关性保持一致。

blocks.en:
We additionally conduct a qualitative analysis of broadcast state for goal
predictions. An event is labeled broadcast when the clip contains its
original occurrence and recap when a later segment revisits an earlier
event. Broadcast state is determined manually by inspecting the surrounding
temporal context.

blocks.en:
Among four manually inspected goal predictions from one representative match,
three correspond to the original broadcast occurrence and one to a recap. In
the recap case, a previously occurring scoring sequence is shown again and
interpreted as a new goal. Although this small qualitative sample does not
support estimating a general recap-confusion rate, it demonstrates that
recap content can produce false-positive event detections despite explicit
prompt instructions to distinguish live events from retrospective footage.

blocks.en:
These observations suggest that prompt-based broadcast-state reasoning can
handle some replay or recap sequences but is not fully reliable. Explicit
broadcast-state modeling may provide a more robust mechanism for distinguishing
new events from retrospective content.

这些意见表明,即时广播状态推理可以

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en:
This work presented a zero-shot multimodal framework for soccer event spotting,
temporal localization, and excitement scoring from complete match broadcasts
without task-specific parameter fine-tuning. Across three annotated matches
with 130 events from six categories, we evaluated multiple models, input
representations, temporal settings, and prompt-optimization strategies. Combining
visual and commentary evidence improved event spotting, while storyboard input
provided strong performance at lower inference cost than individual-frame
multimodal input. Prompt optimization changed precision–recall and class-level
behavior but did not consistently improve overall performance.

blocks.en: Excitement scores showed positive rank agreement with two LLM-based evaluators, with particularly strong agreement from the GPT-based judge. However, the excitement analysis remains model-based and requires human validation to establish alignment with perceived highlight relevance. The three-match evaluation limits conclusions about generalization across leagues, broadcast styles, and commentary conditions. Sparse frame sampling may omit short-duration visual cues, while replay and recap sequences can introduce false-positive detections. CALF and NetVLAD++ are evaluated cross-dataset without retraining, so annotation and broadcast differences may affect the comparison.
blocks.zh: 激动人心的分数显示,与两名基于LLM的评价员取得了积极的排名一致,特别得到基于GPT的法官的强烈同意。 然而,兴奋度分析仍以模型为基础,需要人类验证,以确定与所感知的突出关联性的一致性。 三场比赛的评价限制了跨联赛,广播风格,评论条件的概括性结论. Sparse帧采样可能会省略短时间的视觉提示,而重播和复刻序列可以引入假阳性检测. CALF和NetVLAD++在没有再培训的情况下评价交叉数据集,因此注释和广播差异可能影响比较.

blocks.en:
Overall, the results demonstrate the potential of general-purpose multimodal
models for soccer video understanding, while motivating larger-scale evaluation,
better replay handling, and human validation of highlight relevance.
blocks.zh:
总的来看,这些结果显示了通用多式联运的潜力。
足球视频理解模型,同时激励更大规模的评价,
更好的回放处理, 人类验证突出的相关性。
